keyFindings.description: The overrun text (main.go:1455-1459, README.md:207-210, receive.go:94-98, changelog pr2404-Changed-20261028-102427.yaml:22-25) says a stop past the 10 s budget loses its mark only if the runtime kills the process, and that the hand-back runs on to its own bounds. The shutdown instead goes on at once to server.Shutdown with the spent context, the live drain, client.Drain (the subscription's own connection) and os.Exit(1), so the listener's own exit cuts off a hand-back still draining or writing its mark. 'leaving the HTTP stop below none of it', 'leaves the HTTP stop below none of it' and 'which an overrun leaves none of the budget' do not parse.

The no-mark table checks hand_back_marked and linger_end only, so the stale-binding row passes if the drain gate fires and the drain row passes on any gate; add a noMark column asserted against end["no_mark"] in every row, and use lingerEndUntaken and lingerEndTimeout in rows 1-2.
